verdict.rationale: Recruitee's first-party material lists 'Applicant management & pipeline' as a feature and says recruiters can 'create and manage your job openings, hiring pipelines', which suggests configurable per-job pipelines. Both are only headline-level mentions, with no detail on how stages are configured. missing for 10: evidence of custom stage configuration per job, drag-and-drop candidate movement, bulk actions across the pipeline, in-depth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
